race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
race.verdict: An open-looking handicap in which it could pay to side with UNDER THE SUN , who has been finding his feet for James Owen in recent weeks and can take advantage of a much reduced mark sporting a reapplied tongue tie. El Fox will no doubt be popular arriving on a C&D hat-trick so she's put forward as the main danger, with Mr Fustic next best. UNDER THE SUN EL FOX MR FUSTIC (IRE)
